sources.title: Guide to BART (Bidirectional & Autoregressive Transformer)
sources.snippet: Q1. What is BART, and how does it stand out in NLP? Ans. BART is a unique model in NLP that integrates the strengths of bidirectional encoding (like BERT) and autoregressive decoding (like GPT). This combination enables BART to excel in both understanding and generating coherent text, making it suitable for diverse tasks such as summarization, translation, and question-answering.
